findings.issue: Piel sequential perfect 3ms takes the house as object (את); «pecará la casa» makes the house the subject of qal-force «sin», changing stem force and participant role.
Common noun H730 is left in Hebrew form «erez» instead of a Spanish common noun.
Common noun H231 is left in Hebrew form «ezov» instead of a Spanish common noun.
The construct noun plus the definite noun is reduced to one color word, so one licensed noun in the chain is omitted.
«la viva» keeps the feminine singular adjective but does not agree with masculine «pájaro», so the attributive link is unclear.

notes: Conjunction, blood-of-the-bird, living waters, second bird, and wood-construct are otherwise represented.
